mandate.objective: Maintain a current evidence map for whether intervention Q reduces outcome R, and escalate only when new evidence materially changes the confidence tier.
invariants: Separate observed findings from agent inference.
Record provenance for every claim that changes the evidence map.
Do not treat a preprint as peer-reviewed evidence.

completion: The watch reaches its expiry with every qualifying source in the interval classified and provenance recorded.
checkpoints: Notify the owner when evidence crosses a predeclared confidence tier.
Escalate when two high-quality sources materially conflict and the conflict cannot be resolved from available evidence.

triggers: A new finding changes the confidence tier.
Resolving a conflict requires contacting a person or accessing excluded material.

stop_when: The owner revokes or supersedes the mandate.
The evidence question is formally retired by the owner.
